source.note: Addresses are source-declared candidates, not proof of retail lavender enablement or QEMU implementation.

entries.name: gic-distributor
entries.notes: Native machine maps QEMU GICv3 distributor at this source-declared candidate; physical register compatibility and retail DTB mapping remain unverified.

entries.name: gic-redistributor
entries.notes: Native machine maps QEMU GICv3 redistributors with 0x20000 stride for eight CPUs; retail DTB and exact hardware geometry remain unverified.

entries.name: uartdm-0c170000
entries.notes: UARTDM prototype is board-mapped at this source-declared candidate; source DTSI marks this node disabled, so retail console selection remains unresolved.

entries.name: uartdm-0c1b0000
entries.notes: Second UARTDM candidate; console selection unresolved.

entries.name: sdhci-emmc
entries.notes: eMMC controller candidate; retail DT/DTBO and storage mode must be verified.

entries.name: sdhci-emmc-cmdq
entries.notes: Separate cmdq_mem range declared adjacent to SDC1.

entries.name: gcc
entries.notes: Register semantics and required clocks/resets remain unimplemented.

entries.name: gpu-clock-controller
entries.notes: Clock/reset registers only; not an Adreno GPU model.
